meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: Claude 会对比 HEAD 与最新发布的 npm 版本,按发布层列出所有未发布的改动,并给出分层影响矩阵和各层的版本升级建议。它会先读 diff 再描述真实改动,而不是照抄 commit 信息。
howto.when: 当你说「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等关键词,或想知道 HEAD 相对已发布版本改了什么时触发;它会直接输出分析,不提问、不寒暄。

say.text: 列出 HEAD 相对最新已发布 npm 版本的所有未发布改动
say.note: 按发布层分组,附分层影响矩阵

say.text: 这次有哪些 breaking change?整体工作流该升哪个版本?
say.note: 标注受影响层并给整体版本号

howto.what_en: Claude compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, lists all unpublished changes by release layer, and gives a layered impact matrix plus per-layer version bump recommendations. It reads diffs instead of copying commit messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', or 'what changed', or when you want to know what HEAD changed versus the published versions. It outputs the analysis directly, with no questions.

say_en.text: List all unpublished changes between HEAD and the latest npm release
say_en.note: Grouped by release layer with a matrix

say_en.text: Break the changes down by omo pure components, omo opencode, and omo codex
say_en.note: Each layer gets a patch/minor/major suggestion

say_en.text: Any breaking changes, and what overall version bump do you recommend?
say_en.note: Marks affected layers and gives one overall bump
